in_sanskrit.name: Patni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lady, Wife
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Patni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who is the embodiment of love, care, and nurturing. She is the companion, the best friend, and the confidant.

in_hindi.name: Patni
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lady, Wife
in_hindi.long_meaning: Patni एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who is the embodiment of love, care, and nurturing. She is the companion, the best friend, and the confidant.

in_tamil.name: Patni
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lady, Wife
in_tamil.long_meaning: Patni ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। The one who is the embodiment of love, care, and nurturing. She is the companion, the best friend, and the confidant.

in_telugu.name: Patni
in_telugu.long_meaning: Patni ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। The one who is the embodiment of love, care, and nurturing. She is the companion, the best friend, and the confidant.

in_marathi.name: Patni
in_marathi.long_meaning: Patni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is the embodiment of love, care, and nurturing. She is the companion, the best friend, and the confidant.

in_bengali.name: Patni
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lady, Wife
in_bengali.long_meaning: Patni একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is the embodiment of love, care, and nurturing. She is the companion, the best friend, and the confidant.
